reviewType: Parent-local technical recheck; not an independent audit

findings.requirement: Frozen DTO compatibility: exact approvalAudit {eventId,createdAt}, strict PrivateDraftReview fields, and generic project/site ReviewCheck scope and string ID.
findings.basis: Source schema uses strict objects; focused tests cover accepted and malformed DTOs.

findings.requirement: After healthy publish/rollback, refresh consumes activePublication and presents current publication and review identity without reload.
findings.basis: PublishReview refetches preview and publish endpoints and installs activePublication; bound Chromium workflow observed publish then rollback.

findings.requirement: Requested missing private draft returns API 404 and the detail page takes the not-found path without leaking content.
findings.basis: Requested draft lookup returns null; API and page handle absent draft as not found; focused and full integration suites passed.

findings.requirement: Authorized stale save returns current draft identity/content in 409 without writes; unauthorized callers receive no current content; the losing editor buffer remains available.
findings.basis: Conflict carries currentDraft through the guarded API; editor retains local project state; integration and browser checks passed.

findings.requirement: Draft images render only at the exact canonical owner-preview URL for the encoded media ID.
findings.basis: Renderer compares against the encoded canonical relative URL; focused tests reject absolute/origin-confused, query, fragment, traversal, and wrong-ID forms.

findings.requirement: New content controls use empty defaults; links have no fabricated URL/check time and evidence remains unknown/null until supplied.
findings.basis: Project/block editor defaults and unit/browser assertions agree.

findings.requirement: Candidate commit, frozen base, patch, candidate source tree, remote ref, output manifest and path scope bind exactly.
All candidate matrix source/evidence references resolve against the exact patched replay and committed package.

unresolvedLimits.detail: The maker and local builds have different build IDs and are not byte-identical. Local build and browser run independently bind to the same exact candidate app tree; no claim of identical full build output is made.
The maker's committed static build sentinel scan was hash-verified as package content but not independently repeated in this Parent-local recheck.
Native PostgreSQL concurrency, hosted Auth/MFA, provider Storage approval/network semantics were not exercised.
Deployed origin, CDN/shared cache behavior and live rollback were not exercised.
Physical devices, assistive technology, recovery/restore and manual operations were not exercised.
FINISH-32's independent GPT Plus #2 audit has not been dispatched or performed.
Parent acceptance and canonical integration are separate pending gates.
No production G7 acceptance is claimed.
